note: Schema 2 follows the real VANI buyer-side prompt and IndiaMART's call-quality matrix. Labels made before the real prompt arrived are schema 1 (see 'legacy').

dispositions.name: BuyLead created
dispositions.hint: The buyer confirmed a genuine product requirement and VANI took it forward: details captured, the buyer connected to a live seller, or seller details promised on WhatsApp (BL Approved / BL Enriched).

dispositions.name: Requirement not confirmed
dispositions.hint: Someone spoke, but the buyer never clearly confirmed a product requirement: dropped early, ambiguous, language barrier.

dispositions.name: Wanted the original seller only
dispositions.hint: The buyer only wanted the seller they called, or refused to talk to an AI, and VANI closed the call (BL Deleted: Particular Seller).

dispositions.name: No product requirement
dispositions.hint: Status enquiry, job seeker, someone selling or listing, complaint, banned product or off-topic: no buying requirement (BL Deleted).

dispositions.name: Nobody spoke
dispositions.hint: Silence, dead air, ringing or voicemail: no conversation.

flags.name: Bot made a mistake
flags.hint: looped, hallucinated, misheard badly or wrote down wrong details

flow.inbound_redirect: the buyer called a seller, the seller was unavailable, the call was redirected to VANI
flow.enrichment: the buyer already has a lead and called a seller who was unavailable
flow.redial: VANI called the buyer back after a dropped call

bot_issues.looping_behavior: VANI asked for the same parameter more than 1+2 times, or circled without progress (matrix: fatal if the buyer got irritated or the opportunity was missed)
bot_issues.quantity_probing_error: quantity asked when already given, not asked when it should have been, or the nudge was improper
bot_issues.qty_missed_opportunity: the buyer gave a quantity and VANI did not capture it
bot_issues.quantity_accuracy: quantity captured with a wrong value or unit
bot_issues.spec_missed_opportunity: the buyer gave a specification and VANI did not capture it
bot_issues.spec_accuracy: a specification captured as a different value than the buyer said
bot_issues.wer_error: speech recognition wrote a wrong word that changed a captured detail
bot_issues.additional_details_error: irrelevant or wrong information stored as the buyer's additional details
bot_issues.oncall_astbuy_error: a live seller was available but VANI did not offer the transfer, or the outcome was recorded wrongly
bot_issues.product_accuracy: the wrong product was confirmed or approved
bot_issues.dead_air: silence of more than 5 seconds that VANI did not handle
bot_issues.echoed_value: VANI repeated or paraphrased a value the buyer had just given (breaks the No-Echo rule)
bot_issues.open_ended_question: VANI asked 'anything else?' or another unneeded open question
bot_issues.ignored_buyer_question: the buyer asked something and VANI did not answer or acknowledge it
bot_issues.abrupt_end: VANI ended the call before a proper closing, when it should not have
bot_issues.language_problem: VANI kept a language the buyer struggled with, or mishandled a language switch

fatal.buylead_fatal: the captured BuyLead data is wrong or corrupt (outcome, quantity, specification or product)
fatal.oncall_fatal: the bot flow broke down: looped, hallucinated, ended wrongly or ignored a live-seller opportunity

call_end.transferred_to_seller: buyer agreed and was connected to a live seller
call_end.seller_details_by_whatsapp: VANI promised seller details on WhatsApp

buyer_requests.seller_contact: asked for the original seller or their number
buyer_requests.alternate_seller: asked to be connected to another seller
buyer_requests.selling_related: wants to sell or list on IndiaMART
buyer_requests.complaint: complained about something outside the call
buyer_requests.talking_to_ai: asked if it is a bot or refused to talk to one
